properties.description: It's 1928, and you've been fleeing the firing squad for over a decade. Turning to infamous crime boss Tommy Shelby (Cillian Murphy) for help, you become embroiled in the hunt for Winston Churchill's Red Box: a briefcase containing the identities of every British agent around the globe.\n\nAs you're drawn deeper into England's criminal underworld, you find yourself at war once again. Enemy factions are closing in, and they all want the box: for power, for money, and the chance to bring the country to its knees. Keep your wits about you as simmering tensions explode into intense action, defeat the odds and bring back the box... BY ORDER OF THE PEAKY BLINDERS!
properties.short_description: In 1928, a fugitive seeks help from a crime boss to retrieve a briefcase containing secrets that could change the balance of power in Britain.

short_descriptions.value: 1928 sucht ein Flüchtiger die Hilfe eines Verbrecherbosses, um einen Koffer mit Geheimnissen zu holen, die die Macht in Großbritannien verändern könnten.
En 1928, un fugitivo busca la ayuda de un jefe criminal para recuperar un maletín con secretos que podrían cambiar el poder en Gran Bretaña.
En 1928, un fugitif demande l'aide d'un chef du crime pour récupérer une mallette contenant des secrets pouvant changer l'équilibre du pouvoir en Grande-Bretagne.
In 1928, a fugitive seeks help from a crime boss to retrieve a briefcase containing secrets that could change the balance of power in Britain.

properties.description: PeakPals presents a game where you and your friends try to reach the top. You can go alone, but isn't it more fun when your friend shoots you down? Well, maybe not for you. \r\n\r\nThe game tests your nerves as you constantly fall down, and even if you happen to succeed and climb higher, someone can still shoot you down, throw a grenade, or simply hit you with a baseball bat.
properties.short_description: Players compete to reach the top while facing sabotage from friends, testing their nerves in a chaotic climb.

short_descriptions.value: Spieler kämpfen darum, den Gipfel zu erreichen, während sie Sabotage von Freunden ausgesetzt sind und ihre Nerven bei einem chaotischen Aufstieg testen.
Los jugadores compiten para llegar a la cima enfrentando sabotajes de amigos, poniendo a prueba sus nervios en una escalada caótica.
Les joueurs s'affrontent pour atteindre le sommet tout en subissant les sabotages de leurs amis, testant leurs nerfs dans une ascension chaotique.
Players compete to reach the top while facing sabotage from friends, testing their nerves in a chaotic climb.

properties.description: Travel around The Great Gales to climb challenging peaks in this physics-based climbing adventure set in 1887. Meet like-minded mountaineers, unlock helpful climbing gear, and become a pioneer of mountaineering.\r\n
properties.short_description: In 1887, players embark on a physics-based climbing adventure to conquer challenging peaks and become pioneers of mountaineering.

short_descriptions.value: Im Jahr 1887 begeben sich die Spieler auf ein physikbasiertes Kletterabenteuer, um herausfordernde Gipfel zu bezwingen und Pioniere des Bergsteigens zu werden.
En 1887, los jugadores emprenden una aventura de escalada basada en la física para conquistar picos desafiantes y convertirse en pioneros del montañismo.
En 1887, les joueurs se lancent dans une aventure d'escalade basée sur la physique pour conquérir des sommets difficiles et devenir des pionniers de l'alpinisme.
In 1887, players embark on a physics-based climbing adventure to conquer challenging peaks and become pioneers of mountaineering.
